title: The Bingo Hall Recipe Leak
intro: Someone has leaked Edna's secret pound cake recipe during the retirement home's bingo night, and the card in her handbag is now missing.

suspects.name: Walter
suspects.line: I came late because my hip is a grumpy old thing.

suspects.name: Harold
suspects.line: I was at the snack table the whole time, I swear.

suspects.name: Rosie
suspects.line: Bingo is my life, and I am very lucky at it.

suspects.name: Mabel
suspects.line: I only ever dab, dear. Never a drop on my hands.

suspects.name: Gloria
suspects.line: My recipe? Never heard of it. Now, B-7, anyone?

clues.text: A smudge of blue ink on the cage handle shows the culprit had ink-stained fingers from handling the card.
A lavender cardigan hangs untouched here, so the culprit is not the one wearing that cardigan tonight.
The door log proves the culprit was not late; they were already seated before the second game of the night began.
The sign-in sheet shows the culprit arrived early, scribbling their name before the first caller had even warmed up.
